Return distinct activity records for compounds tested against the human single-protein target hepatocyte growth factor receptor (CHEMBL3717) with IC50 values in nM. Include compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer PubMed ID, fallback DOI), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Only include rows where canonical SMILES is available and the document has a PubMed ID or DOI.
